notes: The knight's sword at the low-ready while crouched (mw-a6t): the right elbow bent and the hand held out from the hip, the blade pointing out and away at a low angle instead of hanging straight down. Same length as anim-humanoid-crouch-idle, so its blend shares the phase of the base layer's. Arms hang down, so a positive x swings them forward and a positive z swings the right arm out. The sword bone is untracked in every move's clip, so a move eases it back to the grip.
